findings.source: Hunter: Конечно, у меня руки будут грязные, я хожу по ночам копать этих чертей.
findings.currentTarget: Hunter: Normal că am mâinile murdare, umblu noaptea și-i dezgrop pe diavolii ăștia.
findings.reason: Russian «хожу по ночам копать этих чертей» says he goes out digging for the creatures; Romanian «îi dezgrop» asserts that he digs the creatures up from where they were buried. The scene does not establish burial.
